value.question: Does the buyback flow offset a meaningful share of new NEAR?
value.why: Measured in NEAR, so price does not matter. 25% would mean buybacks soak up a quarter of dilution.

value.question: Is bought-back NEAR still being held (not sold or moved)?
value.why: Holding is the only thing that makes buybacks reduce float. Rolling 90-day window; the 12,000 NEAR move on 10 Jul (2.3% of the balance then) is disclosed in THESIS.md.

value.question: Is Intents volume growing?
value.why: All-Intents volume (DefiLlama), last 4 weeks vs the 12 weeks before.

value.question: Is NEAR's cut of Intents volume high enough?
value.why: Captured revenue / volume. Today's value is about 5 bps.

value.question: Does captured revenue cover the dollar value of new issuance?
value.why: Revenue in USD / issuance x price, both annualised.

value.question: Is real on-chain usage back to where it started the year?
value.why: Weekly accounts that are both engaged and returning (L4), the most conservative user count.

value.question: Is the valuation within reach of the captured cash flow?
value.why: Market cap / annualised captured Intents revenue.

scorecard.method: each signal: green if its bullish condition holds, red if its bearish condition holds, else yellow

scorecard_verdict.method: red > green -> bearish verdict; green > red and at least half green -> bullish; otherwise mixed

thesis_claim.value: NEAR is a call option on NEAR Intents: the demand is real and some of it is bought back and held, but not yet enough to outweigh issuance or justify the valuation.
